coverage.summary: Owners of any housing accommodation in California. The subsidy-specific income-standard and credit-history rules apply only where there is a government rent subsidy.
coverage.owner_conditions: Per the CRD FAQ (not the statute text): an owner-occupant renting to one additional person may exclude applicants on protected characteristics but may not publish discriminatory statements or ads.
coverage.other_conditions: Per the CRD FAQ: shared living areas in a single dwelling may be limited to one sex, and housing specifically for seniors may be limited by age.

evidence.quoted_span: For the owner of any housing accommodation to discriminate against or harass any person because of the race
In instances in which there is a government rent subsidy, to do either of the following:
When an owner is occupying a home and is renting to one additional person, the owner may exclude applicants based on protected characteristics.
However, the owner still cannot make, print, or publish discriminatory statements, notices, or advertisements.
When sharing a living area in a single dwelling, the owner or occupant may state or imply that the housing is available only to person of one sex.
Housing specifically for seniors may be limited based on age.

result.notes: Three coverage fields are set: summary, owner_conditions and other_conditions. Each has verbatim support. The summary is supported by D027 subdivisions (a) and (o)(1). The owner-occupant, single-sex shared living and senior housing limits come from the CRD FAQ (D016), not the statute text. In other_conditions, 'qualifying senior housing' was reworded to 'housing specifically for seniors' to match the source wording. owner_occupied_exemption_max_units stays null: the FAQ says 'one additional person', not a unit count. No construction-date, unit-count, landlord-size or preemption terms appear in the documents for this rule.
